# High-level languages

Source: [wiki article 8308](../archive/8308.md); edited 2026-03-03.

<a id="wiki-8308-n1"></a>

- HLL workflow edits external source, compiles to Workshop clipboard text, and retains external-source benefits such as Git, multi-file structure, macros and enum checking.

<a id="wiki-8308-n2"></a>

- Article describes OverPy as a close Workshop wrapper emphasizing preprocessing/macros rather than new runtime abstractions.

<a id="wiki-8308-n3"></a>

- String splitting and element-count optimizations can be compiler responsibilities while source remains readable.
